valuation.description: valuation is the new valuation of the NFT

max_annual_pct_fee.description: max_annual_pct_fee (optional) is the maximum annual percentage fee the user is willing to pay for setting the new valuation (e.g. "0.025" for 2.5%). This guards against unexpected fee amounts if the name owner changes the annual_pct.
